title: Deployment
deploymentType_tooltip: Bare Metal: direct hardware sizing. Virtual Machine: applies VM overhead factors (CPU ×0.78, storage ×0.86) requiring more physical nodes.
ece_tooltip: Elastic Cloud Enterprise: container-based orchestration on Dell hardware. Applies overhead factors (CPU x0.72, storage x0.82) for container and allocator overhead.
serverModel_tooltip: Dell PowerEdge server for data nodes. R760 (2U) suits data-heavy tiers. R660 (1U) is used for infrastructure roles. R7725 (AMD EPYC) offers maximum memory for large hot tiers.
cpuOption_tooltip: CPU model installed in the selected server. More cores improve indexing parallelism and search throughput on hot tier nodes.
memoryPerNode_tooltip: RAM per data node. Directly controls node count: more RAM per node = fewer nodes needed. JVM heap is set to 50% of RAM, capped at 31 GB (compressed OOPs limit).
storageModel_tooltip: Dell PowerStore model for hot/warm SAN storage. Larger models offer more raw capacity and higher IOPS. Used to calculate PowerStore unit count in the BOM.
frozenBackend_tooltip: Object storage backend for frozen tier searchable snapshots. PowerScale: Dell scale-out NAS with S3 protocol. ECS: Dell native object storage with S3-compatible API.
networkSpeed_tooltip: Server network uplink speed. 25 GbE is standard for most deployments. 100 GbE is recommended for R7725 or very high indexing rates (>500K docs/sec).
